title: The Lake and the Green Workshop
overview: Anne has achieved her long cherished dream, but at great cost. She sets off to a new town determined to earn the title she's been given and to gain back what she's lost. And so, the next chapter of Anne's adventure begins!

title: Embarking on a Challenge Once Again
overview: Anne focuses on her new job at the Paige Workshop, but the artisans there work in a way so different from other workshops that she feels quite lost. Given that the orders for their sugar confections have been decreasing, she has her work cut out for her!

title: Sugar Confections in the Service of Others
overview: Anne wants to enter the selection for the Holy Beginnings Festival’s sugar confection. Glen refuses due to the policies of his predecessor. Anne thinks it’s a chance to rebuild the workshop, but will she be able to get everyone to pull together in time?

title: The First Silver Sugar
overview: Elliott has been attacked and injured, but the questions surrounding the incident can't stop the work for the upcoming selection. Anne, Orland, and the others talk things out and decide on a motif of snow for Mister Glen, but how will they give it form?

title: The Castle with No Crest
overview: Anne decides to stay with the Paige Workshop, determined to see her work through to the end. They're sent to a castle to use as both lodgings and workplace in order to begin crafting, but the place has a strange atmosphere about it.

title: Ghosts Aren't Scary
overview: To preserve the peace of Holly Leaf Castle, Mithril Lid Pod organizes a ghost hunt with himself as leader. That night, Challe captures the ghost who, as it turns out, has a deep connection to the castle and is determined to protect it.

title: Wanting Even a Cat's Help
overview: The silver sugar has hardened due to the heavy rains. Anne and the others come up with a plan of action, but they're short on time and manpower. Anne and Elliott decide to ask for Kat's help, but will the maverick artisan agree?

title: A Purple Promise
overview: Anne has challenged Hugh to a competition. She tries to think of a motif that might delight Noah, who still loves and misses Lord Herbert. When the time comes, Noah looks at the sugar confections before him and the one he quickly takes in his hand is...

title: The Red Fairy
overview: Gladus has revealed his true nature. As he leaves, he attacks Orland. When Bridget hears that Orland's been hurt as a result of Gladus using her, she's horrified. Hugh reminds them that they're still working under a deadline. How will they make it now?

title: Fairies and Humans and...
overview: With both Anne and his wing taken from him, Challe follows Lafalle, doing as he's ordered. They arrive at Lafalle's stronghold, an abandoned fortress. Lafalle speaks of their origins and invites Challe to join him in inheriting the will of the fairy king.

title: The One to Become the Fairy King
overview: Anne is angered and saddened by the fairies' reaction to Lafalle's control over them. Lafalle forces Challe to help steal silver sugar and demands that Anne make sugar confections for him. Because of him, things between Anne and Challe become strained.

title: A New Form
overview: Challe takes up his blade to stop Lafalle. Anne worries for Lusul and the warrior fairies who helped her. In this world where sugar confections bring good fortune, a silver sugar master and a black fairy fight to hold on to their hopes for the future.
